scope: 30 case sampled full-timeline contact sheets: six evenly spaced third-person frames plus final head/chest views per case; not frame-by-frame video review

observations.tilted: Final head/chest views show displaced/tilted manipulated cup near hand; no sampled visual evidence contradicts rejection. Small cup and occlusion limit exact angle judgement; angle and contact values remain trace measurements.
observations.held_on_pad: Final images show robot fingers remaining at/on the cup at the pad; contact exclusion is appropriate. Images alone do not establish grasp force, so category is robot-contact-on-pad rather than confirmed forceful holding.
observations.out_of_region: Final images show the manipulated cup away from its original pad, including lifted or hand-contact cases; target-pad vacancy visible. These are not isolated region-only negatives.

limitations: Only sampled frames were reviewed, not all frames of 30 videos.
Categories overlap; this is not a counterfactual one-condition unit test.
Exact XY, upright cosine and robot contact are taken from 120Hz logs, not estimated visually.
